name: EFC (I) Limited
summary: EFC (I) Limited engages in the provision of real estate services in India and internationally. It operates through the Rental, Interior, and Furniture segments. The company engages in the development, buying, selling, leasing, operation, and management of managed office and coworking spaces; provision of turnkey interior design and execution solutions, as well as interior designing consultancy; manufacturing and supplying furniture for commercial and other spaces; and manufactures, sells, purchases, imports, and exports furniture and fixtures.
